notes: Card: ' والم' x5, ' m' x4, '(m' x4, ' الم' x4, ' пом' x3: a word-initial m family across scripts. Probe: ' والم' 0.70-0.97, ' بالم' 0.53; but Latin ' m' is erratic (midafternoon 0.82, mosaics 0.04) and Cyrillic ' м' 0.19, so the label stays with the Arabic pieces. Near misses use the same prefixes with other letters. Tokenizer checked for every fire word.
